newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market on the bearish mood-shares fall.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market on the bearish mood-shares fall.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market fell on Tuesday as some investors put pressure on heavyweights to bring prices down.
Two independent indices, the VAB-RASDAQ and the BIG-OTC -- computed by VANGUARD and BIG brokerage houses -- dropped by 1.80 and 2.52 percent respectively to 3,613.13 and 2,700.36 points.
Tumbling prices of Sidex steel mill depressed the VAB-RASDAQ index, VANGUARD said. Sidex closed 1,000 lei weaker at 16,000.
Traders said further lows in high-caps were expected for the next session. But they still believed the market would recover towards the end of the week.
"Why not push prices down if sellers agree to it?" one operator said. "But that kind of play cannot last too long."
Cement maker Romcif was again the most traded stock and closed flat at 1,800 lei.
Other cement makers Romcim and Casial slipped 2,000 and 200 lei to close at 63,000 and 2,100 respectively.
Oil refinery Arpechim inched down 500 lei to 27,500.
Over 3.7 million shares changing hands on turnover of 9.48 billion lei, 2.55 billion up from the previous session. ($=7,090 lei)
